lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਰਾਇ ਕਮਾਲਦੀ ਮੋਜਦੀ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਕੀ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਰਿ ਗਾਵਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee kee vaar mahalaa 5 raai kamaaladee mojadee kee vaar kee dhun upar gaavanee ||
lines.translation: Gauree Kee Vaar, Fifth Mehl: Sung To The Tune Of Vaar Of Raa-I Kamaaldee-Mojadee:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਜਪੈ ਸੋ ਆਇਆ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam jo jan japai so aaiaa paravaan ||
lines.translation: Auspicious and approved is the birth of that humble being who chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਭਜਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis jan kai balihaaranai jin bhajiaa prabh nirabaan ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to that humble being who vibrates and meditates on God, the Lord of Nirvaanaa.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran dukh katiaa har bhetiaa purakh sujaan ||
lines.translation: The pains of birth and death are eradicated, upon meeting the All-knowing Lord, the Primal Being.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t sa(n)g saagar tare jan naanak sachaa taan ||1||
lines.translation: In the Society of the Saints, he crosses over the world-ocean; O servant Nanak, he has the strength and support of the True Lord. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਲਕੇ ਉਠਿ ਪਰਾਹੁਣਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhalake uth paraahunaa merai ghar aavau ||
lines.translation: I rise up in the early morning hours, and the Holy Guest comes into my home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਉ ਪਖਾਲਾ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਿਤ ਭਾਵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: paau pakhaalaa tis ke man tan nit bhaavau ||
lines.translation: I wash His feet; He is always pleasing to my mind and body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam sune naam sa(n)grahai naame liv laavau ||
lines.translation: I hear the Naam, and I gather in the Naam; I am lovingly attuned to the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: grihu dhan sabh pavitr hoi har ke gun gaavau ||
lines.translation: My home and wealth are totally sanctified as I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har naam vaapaaree naanakaa vadabhaagee paavau ||2||
lines.translation: The Trader in the Lord's Name, O Nanak, is found by great good fortune. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਭਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai so bhalaa sach teraa bhaanaa ||
lines.translation: Whatever pleases You is good; True is the Pleasure of Your Will.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: too sabh mahi ek varatadaa sabh maahi samaanaa ||
lines.translation: You are the One, pervading in all; You are contained in all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜੀਅ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: thaan thana(n)tar rav rahiaa jee a(n)dar jaanaa ||
lines.translation: You are diffused throughout and permeating all places and interspaces; You are known to be deep within the hearts of all beings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)g mil paaeeai man sache bhaanaa ||
lines.translation: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and submitting to His Will, the True Lord is found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak prabh saranaagatee sad sad kurabaanaa ||1||
lines.translation: Nanak takes to the Sanctuary of God; he is forever and ever a sacrifice to Him. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੇਤਾ ਈ ਤਾਂ ਚੇਤਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: chetaa ee taa(n) chet saahib sachaa so dhanee ||
lines.translation: If you are conscious, then be conscious of the True Lord, Your Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਚੜਿ ਬੋਹਿਥਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak satigur sev chaR bohith bhaujal paar pau ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, come aboard upon the boat of the service of the True Guru, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਊ ਸੰਦੇ ਕਪੜੇ ਪਹਿਰਹਿ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaaoo sa(n)de kapaRe pahirahi garab gavaar ||
lines.translation: He wears his body, like clothes of wind - what a proud fool he is!

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਨੀ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਹੋਏ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naal na chalanee jal bal hoe chhaar ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they will not go with him in the end; they shall be burnt to ashes. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਗੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੋ ਸਚੈ ਰਖੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: seee ubare jagai vich jo sachai rakhe ||
lines.translation: They alone are delivered from the world, who are preserved and protected by the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਹਿ ਡਿਠੈ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਜੀਵੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚਖੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: muhi dithai tin kai jeeveeai har a(n)mrit chakhe ||
lines.translation: I live by beholding the faces of those who taste the Ambrosial Essence of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧਾ ਭਖੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohu sa(n)g saadhaa bhakhe ||
lines.translation: Sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment are burnt away, in the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਪਰਖੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh aapanee har aap parakhe ||
lines.translation: God grants His Grace, and the Lord Himself tests them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਲਤ ਨ ਜਾਪਨੀ ਕੋ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਲਖੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak chalat na jaapanee ko sakai na lakhe ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, His play is not known; no one can understand it. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਈ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਸੁਹਾਵੜਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਵੈ ਚਿਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak soee dinas suhaavaRaa jit prabh aavai chit ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, that day is beautiful, when God comes to mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਫਿਟੁ ਭਲੇਰੀ ਰੁਤਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jit din visarai paarabraham phit bhaleree rut ||1||
lines.translation: Cursed is that day, no matter how pleasant the season, when the Supreme Lord God is forgotten. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak mitraaee tis siu sabh kichh jis kai haath ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, become friends with the One, who holds everything in His hands.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੁਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਸੇਈ ਕਾਂਢੀਅਹਿ ਇਕ ਵਿਖ ਨ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kumitraa seee kaa(n)dheeahi ik vikh na chalahi saath ||2||
lines.translation: They are accounted as false friends, who do not go with you, for even one step. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਪੀਵਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit naam nidhaan hai mil peevahu bhaaee ||
lines.translation: The treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is Ambrosial Nectar; meet together and drink it in, O Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਭ ਤਿਖਾ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis simarat sukh paaeeai sabh tikhaa bujhaaee ||
lines.translation: Remembering Him in meditation, peace is found, and all thirst is quenched.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਭੁਖ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar sevaa paarabraham gur bhukh rahai na kaaee ||
lines.translation: So serve the Supreme Lord God and the Guru, and you shall never be hungry again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੁੰਨਿਆ ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal manorath pu(n)niaa amaraa pad paaee ||
lines.translation: All your desires shall be fulfilled, and you shall obtain the status of immortality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tudh jevad toohai paarabraham naanak saranaaee ||3||
lines.translation: You alone are as great as Yourself, O Supreme Lord God; Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਡਿਠੜੋ ਹਭ ਠਾਇ ਊਣ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dithaRo habh thaai oon na kaaee jaai ||
lines.translation: I have seen all places; there is no place without Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਧਾ ਤਿਨ ਸੁਆਉ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ladhaa tin suaau jinaa satigur bhetiaa ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who meet with the True Guru find the object of life. ||1||
